title: Chat
summary: Team chats and direct messages: mentions, voice notes, PDFs, pins, seen by, search, mute and block.

blocks.text: Team › Chat has a chat for each of your teams, plus direct messages (New message).

items: **@mentions**: type @ and pick a name. They are told even if they muted the chat.
**Voice notes**: tap the microphone, talk, then tap Send (up to 5 minutes). On the website the 🎤 shows in browsers that can record (Safari, recent Chrome and Edge). Everyone can play them.
**Documents**: 📎 sends a PDF up to 10 MB.
**Pinned messages** stay at the top, up to 20 per chat. In a team chat admins and shift leads pin; in a direct message either person can.
**Seen by**: on your own message, ⋯ › Seen by lists who has read it.
**Search** finds messages and PDF names in the chats you can see. Deleted messages are never found.
A message that couldn't be sent shows Not sent, tap to retry. Retrying never sends it twice.
Mute a chat with the bell. Chat settings can also hide message text in notifications.
Long-press (or ⋯) a message to copy it, turn it into a task, report it, or delete your own.
In a direct message you can hide the conversation or **block** the person. Neither of you can then message the other; in team chats their messages fold away.
Offensive words are hidden automatically. The [Team rules](article:team-rules) apply to everything.
